passage:
Dear Ms. Aris,

I watched your recent documentary about planting trees in big cities last month, and I really loved what you said about how a healthy city needs enough shade for all of its residents. That idea really stayed with me, and it is the main reason I am reaching out to you today. On behalf of our board of directors at the Metropolitan Tree Trust, I would be honored to invite you to be our main speaker at our 15th annual "Green Horizons" Charity Gala on Saturday, June 20th.

For the past ten years, our team has been working hard to turn old, abandoned industrial areas into beautiful community orchards. This year, we are hoping to raise $450,000 for our new "Schoolyard Canopy" project. Our plan is to plant over 2,000 native maple and oak trees across twelve local elementary school campuses by the end of this fall. Because you have spent so many years caring about nature and making sure everyone gets equal access to green spaces, you are the perfect person to inspire our guests and show them how their donations can make a real, lasting difference for these kids.

The event will be held at the Glass Pavilion inside the Botanical Gardens. The night will start with welcome drinks at 6:30 PM, where you will have a chance to mingle with the guests, followed by a delicious formal dinner. Your speech is scheduled for 8:15 PM and will last about twenty minutes, right before our main live auction begins. We are expecting around 350 guests, including city leaders, local business owners, and several generous donors who have specifically mentioned that your work inspired them to support environmental causes in our community.

We know your time and knowledge are very valuable, so we are happy to offer you $5,000 for your presentation, along with fully paid travel arrangements and a stay at the Fairmont Hotel. Above all, this is a great chance to share your vision with a room full of people who are ready and excited to help build a cleaner, greener city.

We would love to chat more about your speech topic and any equipment you might need. Since there is a lot to organize, please let us know by April 15th if you are interested. I really hope we can work together to make this our best event yet!

Best regards,
Jonathan Miller
Director, Metropolitan Tree Trust
